author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Title says it all. PR https://github.com/cms-sw/cmssw/pull/52404 added a `fillDescriptions` to `MEtoEDMConverter` and the now  `deleteAfterCopy`  becomes a invalid parameter. This makes a test fail in IBs [log](https://cmssdt.cern.ch/SDT/cgi-bin/logreader/el8_amd64_gcc14/CMSSW_20_1_X_2026-11-07-1100/unitTestLogs/CalibTracker/SiStripChannelGain#/).

#### PR validation:

None, to be tested by the bot.

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:

Not a backport, not to be backported.
title: remove deprecated `deleteAfterCopy` parameter from `MEtoEDMConverter` instances
